decisive_items: Bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium
Villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia
Immunostaining negative for S100 and CD34
response.rationale: Histopathologic findings of villous fibroepithelial projections and bland spindle cell proliferation are characteristic of onychopapilloma, while absence of melanocytic lesions and negative S100/CD34 rule out melanonychia. Onychomatricoma is less likely as histology lacks typical fibroepithelial digitations and only clinical nail thickening is noted.

rejected.why: Clinical pigmentation is present but histology shows no melanocytic lesions and negative S100/CD34, ruling out melanonychia.
